source_subtopic_title: Estimands and the target-trial framing for observational questions
evidence_note: Target-trial components and an environmental intervention estimand are specified; no complete protocol template with mock data.

evidence_note: Matching/weighting, DiD, IV, RD, synthetic control and interrupted time series are introduced; no executed design-specific analysis.

source_subtopic_title: Spatial confounding and interference between neighbouring units
evidence_note: Spatial confounding and cross-unit interference are explained with environmental examples; no spatial interference sensitivity exercise.

source_subtopic_title: Difference-in-differences assumptions: parallel trends and anticipation

evidence_note: Urban vegetation/heat is used as an example; the policy/burning case needs a full worked design.

evidence_note: Unmeasured-confounding sensitivity and negative controls are explained; no quantitative sensitivity bound is computed.

evidence_note: The language rule distinguishes association from causation and ties claims to design assumptions; no release-ready manuscript example yet.
